label: A5BC8_cP56_212_cd_a_ce-001
title: ${\alpha}$-LiFe$_{5}$O$_{8}$ Structure
comments:
This is the spinel-like low temperature structure of LiFe$_{5}$O$_{8}$.  Above 720-750$^{\circ}$C the lithium and iron sites are randomly distributed on the cobalt sites of the \href{current_web_home_dir/A3B4_cF56_227_ad_e-001}{$D7_{2}$ cubic spinel structure} (Iliev, 2011). 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/A3B2CD8_cP56_212_d_c_a_ce-001}{Li$_{2}$NiGe$_{3}$O$_{5}$} is an ordered quaternary form of this structure. 
 Space group $P4_{3}32$ \#212 is a \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups/}{Sohncke Class II chiral space group}, so this structure may also be found in the enantiomorphic space group $P4_{1}32$ \#213.
